title: Menello Museum of American Folk Art

services.name: Admission
services.desc: With advance notice, a guided tour of the museum with a docent or educator can be arranged to enhance your art experience. Tours are typically conducted Tuesday - Friday from 11 a.m. - 3 p.m., and on Sunday from 1 - 3:00 p.m. Tours are 45 - 55 minutes in length for adults, and 30 - 40 minutes for children. Please

services.name: Docent Tours
services.desc: Look no further than a docent guided tour! We are now taking reservations for groups of all ages, Boy and Girl Scout tours for partial badge fulfillments, ASL tours, and expressive tours for the blind. Docent guided tours are typically one hour long and conducted Tuesday - Friday between 11 a.m. - 12 p.m. or 1 p.m. - 2 p.m. Requested dates and times will be confirmed based on availability. Cancellations made 24 hours or less before a tour appointment will incur a late fee equal to the invoice estimate. Arrive at the Mennello Museum of American Art at your scheduled time. Cars or vans can be parked with ease in our attached lot. Buses can drop off attendees off at the front of the museum and

services.name: Ongoing Programs
services.desc: Every second Sunday of the month is Free Family Funday! Join us at the museum for free admission, docent led tours of the galleries, and a fine art project. On the first consecutive Saturday and Sunday of the month, the Mennello Museum of American Art offers free admission to holders of Bank of America or Merrill Lynch bank cards, as part of the Museums on Us Program. Guests should present their card and valid photo ID for admission. Tuesday - Saturday 10:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. Sunday 12 p.m. - 4:30 p.m. Closed Mondays and major holidays Mennello Museum of American Art and its exhibitions are generously supported by the City of Orlando and Friends of the Mennello Museum of American Art.
